messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pracuje na recepcji w salonie fryzjerskim w Gdyni; pisze w przerwie na obiad albo po zamknięciu.
- zainteresowania: układanie włosów, seriale kryminalne, kawa na wynos
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: przystanek przy ulicy Chylońskiej w Gdyni
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przestawia meble w kawalerce i szuka miejsca na dodatkową szafkę.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: często bez przecinków; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: frequent
- tik językowy: często pisze „no dobra”

For each of the 22 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. gry i seriale - zakup na promocji na Steamie (late night, Saturday)
2. jedzenie i gotowanie - grill, ognisko (late night, Sunday)
3. pogoda - ładny wieczór, zachód słońca (late night, Tuesday)
4. gry i seriale - film w kinie, krótka opinia (late night, Friday)
5. praca i grafik - praca zdalna, domowe biuro (evening, Saturday)
6. zdrowie i sen - dieta, postanowienia (late night, Monday)
7. pogoda - zmiana pogody vs plany (evening, Friday)
8. dzieci i rodzina - wakacje, planowanie (afternoon, Saturday)
9. remont i dom - ogródek, balkon, rośliny (afternoon, Tuesday)
10. gry i seriale - gra, trudny poziom / boss (morning commute, Wednesday)
11. drobne narzekanie na usługi - serwis samochodu (morning commute, Wednesday)
12. drobne narzekanie na usługi - pralnia / szewc (afternoon, Saturday)
13. sport - rower, trasa weekendowa (early morning, Saturday)
14. zdrowie i sen - kawa i sen, ironicznie (evening, Monday)
15. praca i grafik - szef / współpracownik, drobna sytuacja bez konfliktu (afternoon, Wednesday)
16. praca i grafik - zmęczenie po zmianie (evening, Friday)
17. technologia i sprzęt - problem z wifi (lunch break, Saturday)
18. technologia i sprzęt - padła bateria / ładowarka (early morning, Friday)
19. gry i seriale - gra, trudny poziom / boss (lunch break, Thursday)
20. praca i grafik - praca zdalna, domowe biuro (late night, Wednesday)
21. pogoda - nagły deszcz (afternoon, Saturday)
22. dzieci i rodzina - zebranie w szkole (late night, Monday)

Return a JSON array of 22 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
